description: Client-side script for Lead doctype in ERPNext, defining LeadController class with methods for lead management, UI interactions, and related actions.

classes.name: LeadController
classes.description: Controller class for managing Lead form interactions, including creating related documents, setting queries, and UI updates.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the LeadController, defining make methods and setting required fields.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Sets query filters for customer, lead owner, and contact by fields when the form loads.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, toggles naming series, adds custom buttons, and renders contact info.

methods.name: add_lead_to_prospect
methods.description: Prompts user to select a Prospect and adds the current lead to it.

methods.name: make_customer
methods.description: Creates a Customer document mapped from the Lead.

methods.name: make_opportunity
methods.description: Creates an Opportunity document mapped from the Lead.

methods.name: make_quotation
methods.description: Creates a Quotation document mapped from the Lead.

methods.name: make_prospect
methods.description: Creates a Prospect document pre-filled with Lead data and navigates to it.

methods.name: company_name
methods.description: Sets lead_name to company_name if lead_name is empty.

methods.name: contact_date
methods.description: Adjusts the end date based on contact date.

methods.name: render_contact_day_html
methods.description: Displays contact date status with color indicator.
